it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 31/03/2026, depois que Márcio Lima renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado estadual na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on March 31, 2026, after Mayor Márcio Lima resigned to run for state deputy in the 2026 election.
